card.name: Start of 'Advise' and similar sentences
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long word that begins a sentence or bullet, mostly 'Adv' of 'Advise' in patient-counseling lines. Also 'Comb' of 'Combining' and 'kal' in 'Alkalization'.

modes.label: Advise at sentence start
modes.description: The 'Adv' of 'Advise' opening a counseling instruction after a full stop or bullet.

modes.label: Inside Alkalization
modes.description: The middle piece 'kal' of 'Alkalization' about urine.

modes.description: The first piece of another long word starting a sentence, such as 'Combining'.

card.writes: The promoted words are mostly intensifiers like countless and endless, with no clear link to the text, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the first piece of a split-up word that opens a sentence, especially 'Advise' in counseling instructions.
